info.title: TeslaPool API
info.description:
Transaction-safe, explainable ride pooling for Dhaka.

**Predict → Decide → Guarantee.** ML estimates ETA and fare; deterministic domain rules decide capacity, route feasibility and ride state; PostgreSQL transactions guarantee consistency under concurrency.

Money is integer **poysha** (1 BDT = 100 poysha). Every response uses the `{ success, data | error, meta.requestId }` envelope.
Authenticate with `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, then send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.

message.example: The requested number of seats is not available.

emailVerified.description: True once the user confirmed their email with an emailed code

verificationEmailSent.description: Register only: whether the verification code email went out (resend with POST /auth/email/resend)

retryAfterSeconds.description: Wait this long before asking for another code

headline.example: Not matched: Only 1 seat left, 2 requested

message.example: Same pickup zone as current passengers

rideRequestId.description: Only visible to the driver, admins, and the passenger themself

flexibility.description: URGENT riders need an almost direct route

allOf.description: Only visible to the driver, admins, and the passenger themself

pool.description: The live pool (same shape as GET /pools/{id}) or null when offline

vehicleId.description: Which of my Teslas to drive, e.g. Bullet

detourByFlexibility.description: Each rider’s own detour limit: max(km, ratio × solo distance)

emailVerification.description: required: book, drive and top up only after confirming the email code

amountPoysha.description: Simulated top-up in poysha (৳1 – ৳10,000). No real gateway.

phase.description: PRD tracking vocabulary: WAITING → MATCHED → IN_PROGRESS → COMPLETED / CANCELLED (DRIVER_ARRIVED is still MATCHED)

fareBreakdown.description: Itemised standard fare frozen at request time: base + distance + time = total (hand-verifiable)

eta.description: EtaDecision: finalMinutes, deterministicMinutes, mlPredictedMinutes, source, reason, modelVersion

fare.description: FareDecision: baselineFarePoysha, mlPredictedFarePoysha, guardrailApplied, finalFarePoysha, source, reason, deviationBps, allowedBand, modelVersion

vehicleType.description: Vehicle class to quote and match against; defaults to AUTO_RICKSHAW (a "Tesla").

flexibility.description: How much detour you accept. URGENT: almost direct (the route goes your way first; fewer pools fit). STANDARD: the default limit. FLEXIBLE: you accept a longer ride so more people can share (more pools fit). Your choice only sets your own limit; everyone else keeps theirs.

paymentMethod.description: CASH (collected by the driver) or TESLAPAY (simulated wallet; balance must cover the quoted solo fare).

context.description: Observed conditions. Omitted fields are derived server-side (Dhaka clock). Surge is platform-controlled and cannot be set.

example: You share 55.6% of your ride, so you get a 13.89% pool discount: you pay ৳109.49 instead of ৳127.15 (save ৳17.66).

trip.description: poolId, poolStatus, driverFirstName, vehicle, route, yourPickup/yourDropoff (stop numbers), yourDetourKm, coPassengers (first names only)

fare.description: standard (base + distance + time, itemised), quote (ML/guardrail decision), pooled (solo vs pooled, saving, shared %, discount %), final, lines (plain language)

distanceKm.description: What-if override. Omit to use the server-side zone-graph distance.

capacity.description: Passenger seats; defaults to the vehicle type maximum (Tesla = 3).

post.summary: Register a passenger or driver
Exchange credentials for an access token (also sets an HttpOnly session cookie for browsers)
Clear the HttpOnly session cookie (Bearer clients just drop their token)
Confirm your email with the 6-digit code that was emailed to you

200.description: Email verified; returns the updated user

post.summary: Email a new verification code (voids the previous one; 60 s cooldown)
Email a password reset code. Always answers 202, so it never reveals whether an account exists.

202.description: If the account exists, a code was sent

post.summary: Set a new password with the emailed reset code (also confirms the email address)

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up and serving HTTP (no dependencies checked)
Readiness: database reachable (503 if not). ML status is informational: the API stays ready with deterministic fallback.

post.summary: Driver opens a pool with their vehicle

get.summary: List pools (driver: pools I drive, passenger: pools I ride in, admin: all). Use ?status=ACTIVE for the current one.

schema.description: ACTIVE = OPEN, MATCHED, DRIVER_ARRIVED or STARTED

get.summary: Pool details (driver, admin, or member passenger)

post.summary: Join a specific pool (transactional; re-validates every hard rule under a row lock)
post.description: Rejections return the primary reason as error.code (CAPACITY_EXCEEDED, PICKUP_TOO_FAR, …) and the full explainable decision in error.details.decision.

schema.description: Optional. Replays of the same key+payload return the stored response.

post.summary: Leave a pool before the driver arrives (ride returns to REQUESTED)

schema.description: Optional. Replays of the same key+payload return the stored response.

post.summary: Driver cancels an empty OPEN pool

get.summary: Driver: waiting ride requests evaluated against this pool, with explanations (feasible first, then score, then longest wait)

post.summary: Driver accepts a waiting request into their pool (same transactional join and hard rules as a passenger join)

schema.description: Optional. Replays of the same key+payload return the stored response.

get.summary: Am I online? My live pool (passengers, seats, route) and my vehicles

post.summary: Go online with one of my vehicles (opens a pool). Idempotent: already online with that vehicle returns the live pool.
Go offline (cancels the empty pool). Refused with DRIVER_HAS_PASSENGERS while anyone is assigned.

get.summary: Public reference data for clients: zones (with map centres), vehicle types, enums, ride transitions, business rules. Cacheable.
My simulated TeslaPay balance and ledger (newest first)

post.summary: Simulated top-up (no payment gateway). Use an Idempotency-Key so retries never double-credit.

schema.description: Optional. Replays of the same key+payload return the stored response.

get.summary: Impact + integrity dashboard computed live from the database (trips, pooling, savings, occupancy, capacity violations, ML acceptance) plus in-memory operational latency

post.summary: Request a ride: server-side distance, ML-assisted ETA/fare with guardrails, explainable pool options

schema.description: Optional. Replays of the same key+payload return the stored response.

get.summary: List rides (passenger: own; driver: rides in own pools; admin: all). ?status=ACTIVE returns the current ride.

schema.description: ACTIVE = REQUESTED, MATCHED, DRIVER_ARRIVED or STARTED (a passenger has at most one)

get.summary: Immutable event history of a ride

post.summary: Auto-match: evaluate all candidate pools, then join the best feasible one transactionally
post.description: Returns 200 with decision REJECTED (and per-pool reason codes) when no pool is feasible; the ride stays REQUESTED.

schema.description: Optional. Replays of the same key+payload return the stored response.

post.summary: Cancel (from REQUESTED, MATCHED or DRIVER_ARRIVED only)

schema.description: Optional. Replays of the same key+payload return the stored response.

post.summary: Driver arrived at pickup (MATCHED → DRIVER_ARRIVED). Driver of the ride's pool only.
Passenger picked up (DRIVER_ARRIVED → STARTED); fare locks. Driver of the ride's pool only.
Passenger dropped off (STARTED → COMPLETED); final fare recorded. Driver of the ride's pool only.

get.summary: Explain this ride in plain language: why matched (or not), why this price, and what happened

post.summary: ETA estimate (ML with plausibility guard, deterministic fallback)
Solo fare estimate: deterministic baseline + ML signal + guardrail

patch.summary: Update my name/phone (email, role and status are not self-editable)

post.summary: Register a vehicle (driver only)

patch.summary: Rename, or update capacity / active flag (owner or admin; capacity and active flag are frozen while in a live pool)
